## Hypothesis

The shotgun_scalper strategy captures intraday momentum through volume-expansion triggers and EMA-based exits. This parameter set increases the take-profit target to 75% and tightens the stop loss to 35% to improve asymmetric payoff, while adding a 12-minute time stop and chandelier profit-lock arm at 60% to lock gains earlier and reduce whipsaw losses in choppy regimes.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Trigger when 3-minute volume ratio exceeds 1.2 and strike is offset by 2 strikes from ATM (based on trade direction).  
**Exit:**  
- Take profit at 75% premium gain (`tp_premium_pct=0.75`)  
- Stop loss at 35% premium loss (`stop_premium_pct=-0.35`)  
- Time stop: exit after 12 minutes if neither TP nor SL is hit (`time_stop_min=12`)  
- Chandelier profit-lock: arms at 60% premium gain (`chandelier_arm_pct=0.6`) and trails 15% off high-water mark (trail_pct assumed default)  
- Strike selection: ATM or 1st OTM put/call based on `strike_offset=2`
